sentences.text: The respondents are the appellants in this appeal.
An extent of 0.19 Ares of dry land belonging to the claimant was acquired as per Section 4(1) Notification dated 31.01.2005 under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894.

The Land Acquisition Officer passed Award fixing land value @ Rs.2,69,906/-
per Are, including the land in B Category.

On reference under Section 18, the reference court awarded compensation fixing the land value at the rate of Rs.21,60,000/- per Are, relying on Ext.A1 judgment of the same court in LAR No.675/2009 fixing land value @ Rs.24,00,000/- per Are for A category.
The land value was fixed at Rs.21,60,000/- per Are for B category reducing 10% from the land value of A category.
Ext.A1 judgment was appealed by the State in LAA No.151/2013 and the compensation was reduced fixing the land value at Rs.10,07,600/- per Are.
Hence, the land value awarded by the Reference Court is liable to be interfered with.

Adopting the same criteria followed by the Reference Court, the claimant in this case is entitled to get the land value fixed, reducing 10%
2025:KER:37223 LA.APP. NO. 17 OF 2021 from Rs.10,07,600/- per Are.
Accordingly, the land value in this case is re

-fixed at Rs.9,06,840/- per Are, relying on the judgment in LAA No.151/2013.
2.

Accordingly, the appeal is allowed in part without costs modifying the judgment passed by the Reference Court declaring that the claimant is entitled to get Rs.9,06,840/- per Are for the acquired land, which includes the land value awarded by the Land Acquisition Officer with all statutory benefits and interest as ordered by the Reference Court.

Sd/-
M.A.ABDUL HAKHIM JUDGE shg/
